content: Hypromellose is an ophthalmic solution that has been approved by the FDA for the treatment of eye dryness and for the prevention of further irritation. Additionally, it serves as a protective agent to prevent further irritation. The recommended dosage for adults is to instill 1 or 2 drops into the affected eye(s) as needed. There is limited information available regarding off-label uses of Hypromellose in both adult and pediatric populations. This medication is intended for external use only. It should not be used if the bottle's seal is broken or punctured, or if the solution changes color or becomes cloudy. To avoid contamination, users should not touch the tip of the container to any surface and should replace the cap after each use. If a patient experiences eye pain, changes in vision, persistent redness or irritation, or if symptoms worsen or persist for more than 72 hours, they should discontinue use and consult a physician. Common adverse reactions reported include eye pain and changes in vision. There is no specific guidance from the FDA regarding the use of Hypromellose in pregnant or nursing women, pediatric or geriatric patients, or individuals with renal or hepatic impairment. Similarly, there is no information on its use in specific gender or racial populations, or in immunocompromised patients. Hypromellose is supplied as an ophthalmic solution and should be stored at room temperature between 15°C and 30°C (59°F to 86°F). It should not be frozen, and the packaging should be retained for complete information. Patients should be advised to avoid touching the tip of the container to any surface and to replace the cap after use. If the product is swallowed, medical help or contact with a Poison Control Center is recommended immediately. There is no established interaction between alcohol and Hypromellose, but patients should consult their doctor regarding alcohol consumption while using this medication. The brand name for Hypromellose is GenTeal®.
